newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU set to fix 1995/96 milk "super levy" fines.
newsitem.headline: EU set to fix 1995/96 milk "super levy" fines.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to shortly approve a schedule for Italian, Spanish and Greek dairy farmers to pay "super levy" fines for exceeding 1995/96 milk output quotas, Commission officials said.

The schedule, which has received the backing of an EU agricultural guarantee and guidance committee (EAGGF), involves Italian farmers paying 36.4 million Ecus a month for three months, starting in February.
Spanish farmers would pay 21.75 million Ecus a month for two months and Greek farmers would make a one-off payment of 1.7 million Ecus.

Italian farmers overshot their 9.9 million tonnes quota by some 470,000 tonnes in 1995/96, while Spanish farmers overshot their quota of five million tonnes by some 120,000 tonnes. Greek farmers overshot their quota of around 625,000 tonnes by 7,000 tonnes.
Other member states, such as Britain, with excess milk output have settled their fines, Commission officials said.
